title: Oregon coach Dan Lanning blasts "disgusting play" by USC that injured Dante Moore

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Oregon coach Dan Lanning blasts "disgusting play" by USC that injured Dante Moore
sources.description: Oregon coach Dan Lanning was furious after Saturday's win over USC at the illegal play that knocked Ducks quarterback Dante Moore out of the game and sent him to the hospital.
